title: DHII Engine architecture freeze with Tasks 01-06 creation foundations
summary: Tasks 01-06 accepted: the repo now has a frozen DHII Engine roadmap plus typed, rulebook-backed home-world, background, and role foundations, explainable aptitude composition, a typed in-memory creation draft aggregate, a typed characteristic-generation foundation for standard DHII random-roll and point-allocation modes, and bounded starting-package projection into the legacy Character snapshot. Validation is green locally, including full make ci and coverage-policy checks after adding starting-package coverage.
